title: sourceFileParts
responsibility: Splits a committed source path into its literal folder and filename for SourceFileList.

inputs.name: sourceFileParts.path
inputs.description: Required committed source path. Retains its spelling and accepts the same string operations as the renderer.

inputs.name: sourceFileParts.relativeTo
inputs.description: Required literal owner prefix; removed only when the path starts with it.

outputs.name: sourceFileParts
outputs.description: Folder and filename from the displayed path. Empty paths and trailing separators retain empty parts.

errors.name: Input access error
errors.description: Errors from supplied property or string-operation access propagate unchanged.
